name: BSES Rajdhani Power Ltd. (BRPL)
source: DERC Tariff Order for BRPL FY 2021-22 (30 Sept 2021), Tariff Schedule (page 348) and note 7: 8% towards the accumulated deficit and 7% towards the Pension Trust, on fixed and energy charges. DERC has not issued a newer retail tariff schedule; its 31 Dec 2025 order is a true-up only.

bill_inputs.label: Power purchase adjustment charge (PPAC)
bill_inputs.note: Set by DERC for each DISCOM and changes often. We use the PPAC % printed on your bill, and 0% if it isn't shown.

bill_inputs.label: Electricity tax (municipal)
bill_inputs.note: Levied by the municipal body. We use the rate printed on your bill, and 0% if it isn't shown.

notes: If you get the Delhi government's electricity subsidy, your savings will be lower than shown, because the subsidy already covers part of your bill.

net_metering.note: Extra units are banked for later months. Units left at year end are counted as ₹0.

common_area.note: Separately metered staircase lighting, compound lighting, lifts and water pumps in residential complexes are billed on the Domestic tariff.
common_area.source: DERC Tariff Order for BRPL FY 2021-22 (30 Sept 2021), Other Terms and Conditions, 1.1 Domestic, items (c) and (d) (page 353).
